feature_definition: RATIO_ENTR_LAM = ENTR / %LAM. %LAM = (sum of vertical-line points for qualifying vertical lines l>=l_min=2, main diagonal excluded) / (offdiag recurrence sum). ENTR = -sum p(l)*ln(p(l)) over qualifying diagonal lines (natural log raw, C130/C146-consistent). Delay embedding m=2 tau=1 over trailing window W_RR=168, L-inf recurrence with eps=EPS_SCALE*std(window); causal trailing only; fail-closed to NaN/no-signal if %LAM<=0, no qualifying vertical lines, ENTR undefined/non-finite (ENTR<=0), offdiag/recurrence degenerate, or undefined.
